batches.results: Closed generated webapp/JWT/file input, actual registry app path roundtrip and catalog/platform distinctions. Source fixture does not contain src: removed erroneous ReadResources call, retained failed native log.

Rotated to independent Python and external-name product tests. Local wheel installs despite requirements bypass, survives uninstall, and IPM-only missing-wheel warning differs from ordinary failure. Publishing changes registry key without renaming archived internal module.

Challenged producer sufficiency: copying target existence alone did not prove bytes; added actual content equality and per-file payload contract/control. Reinstall accepted a bare archive declaration, so added package->registry-write->registry-read->reinstall protocol, with controls for dropped declaration and missing publication.
